milestones.title: Diagnosis and contract design
acceptance_criteria: The real flow is mapped
Schema, validator and rubric exist

milestones.title: Structured output and sync
acceptance_criteria: PLAN.json is generated, cross-checked with PLAN.md and frozen per approved revision

milestones.title: Validation and compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Negative tests pass
Historical plans are evaluated read-only
The full planner cycle is reproducible

milestones.title: Documentation and adoption
acceptance_criteria: The contract is documented and routable
A scheduler can parse a plan without agents

tasks.title: Map producers/consumers of SPEC/PLAN/HANDOFF/RUN
tasks.objective: Document the real producers and consumers of SPEC/PLAN/HANDOFF/RUN and the parse grammar
tasks.estimate_rationale: Read-only exploration by a subagent plus direct reads of bt_runstate and bt_launch (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: The map names producers, consumers, task-line grammar, approval mechanics and tests with file:line references

tasks.title: JSON Schema 1.0.0 and validator core
tasks.objective: Publish the 1.0.0 JSON Schema and a hand-written stdlib validator for plans, milestones and tasks
tasks.estimate_rationale: Stdlib-only constraint forces a hand-written validator; schema file kept in step by a parity test (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: Valid plans pass and invalid ones fail naming task and field
Schema enums and required lists equal the validator constants

verification.purpose: Contract, schema parity and negative cases

tasks.title: Classification rubric with boundary examples
tasks.objective: Write the classification rubric with boundary examples
tasks.estimate_rationale: Prose with judgement calls; examples cover sensitive fix, mechanical refactor, contract change, full system (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: Rubric defines the five dimensions and confidence independently
At least the four boundary cases of the design are classified with a reason

verification.purpose: Docs tests keep the reference consistent with the code

tasks.title: PLAN.json generation (init) in the planner flow
tasks.objective: Generate PLAN.json (skeleton) from the existing planner flow without replacing the Markdown
tasks.estimate_rationale: Reuses bt_runstate.parse_plan; init never defaults classification (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: `plan-json init` writes a parseable skeleton from PLAN.md
Classification fields stay absent and are reported as gaps

tasks.title: PLAN.md <-> PLAN.json consistency check
tasks.objective: Check PLAN.md and PLAN.json agree on ids, milestones and dependencies
tasks.estimate_rationale: Compares only structured identifiers, never prose (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: Deliberate inconsistencies fail with the task or milestone named

tasks.title: Immutable approved revisions and run reference
tasks.objective: Freeze approved revisions immutably and let new runs reference them without touching existing RUN.json
tasks.estimate_rationale: Touches launch, run state and the revision store; must never alter a running RUN.json (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: Editing a frozen revision is an error until revision N+1
A new run records plan_ref only when a revision is frozen
Existing RUN.json bytes are unchanged

verification.purpose: Revision, run isolation and launch hook tests

tasks.title: Full validator with negative tests
tasks.objective: Validate duplicates, missing references, cycles, orphan milestones, missing metadata and empty criteria
tasks.estimate_rationale: Graph checks are small; the effort is in negative tests (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: Each listed defect yields a diagnostic naming task and field
No input makes validate() raise

tasks.title: Compatibility report on REQ-013/015/016
tasks.objective: Evaluate the contract against REQ-013, REQ-015 and REQ-016 read-only
tasks.estimate_rationale: Read-only compat over real folders with before/after hashing (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: No file of the three requirements changes
Missing classification is reported, not invented

tasks.title: End-to-end planner cycle test
tasks.objective: Prove the whole planner cycle from objective to frozen revision without starting executors
tasks.estimate_rationale: Integration test with subprocess forbidden by patches (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: Output is canonical and reproducible
No RUN.json and no process is created

tasks.title: Document contract, rubric and review process
tasks.objective: Document contract, rubric and review process and route to it from SKILL.md
tasks.estimate_rationale: Documentation of already implemented behavior (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: A fresh session can run init, check, freeze and compat from the reference alone

tasks.title: Scheduler read-only loader and example input
tasks.objective: Prepare the read-only loader, error codes and example input for a future Scheduler
tasks.estimate_rationale: Loader reuses the validator; the engine is out of scope (classified retrospectively on 2026-10-14; minutes are rough actuals, not a prior estimate)
acceptance_criteria: The example loads without starting processes
Error codes are stable and documented
